pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with distinct, moderately sharp edges. Geometry varies from smaller, more rounded shapes on the lower neck to larger, more angular blocks on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light cream-colored pathways forming a grid-like topology. Nodes are primarily tri-radial or tetra-radial intersections. Line thickness is consistent, approximately 5-10% of the adjacent patch width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark brown, linear ridge along the dorsal neck with low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness against the background.
